Member Function Documentation

void TumbleBUGenInternal::processBlock ( bool &  shouldDelete,
const unsigned int  blockID,
const int  channel 
) throw () [virtual]

Process a block of samples for this blockID and channel.

This is the main rendering function and needs to be implement by all subclasses.

Parameters:
shouldDeleteA UGen graph can be scheduled for deletion by setting this to true on return. If it is already true it should NOT be set to false.
blockIDThis is a sample counter, you can assume that calls to this function will have blockIDs which are higher that the last call (until the maximum integer is reached).
channelThe channel index to process.
